working_memory.text: The footbridge over Lyth Brook has been closed since a survey in June found rot in two of its four main beams. The parish council has ordered replacement timbers, which are due in October, and says the crossing should reopen before the winter. Walkers are being sent round by the ford at Bank End, which adds about a mile to the route. The bridge carries no vehicles.
